rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike beaconing patterns in memory or traffic"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        severity = "critical"
    strings:
        $beacon1 = { 2e 72 63 64 2e 65 78 65 } // ".rcd.exe"
        $beacon2 = "Cookie:" fullword ascii
        $beacon3 = { 47 45 54 20 2f [1-10] 20 48 54 54 50 2f 31 2e 31" } // "GET /<path> HTTP/1.1"
    condition:
        all of them
}

arguments.summary: Malware detected on endpoint 10.0.3.15 (WS-IT-101), identified as Trojan.GenericKD.48571234 with process injection into svchost.exe. A C2 callback was observed to internal IP 10.0.6.88 on port 8443. Further investigation revealed a previously undetected webshell (.shell.php) on the same host. Both IPs had participated in network scanning activity the previous day. The infected host was isolated via automated playbook, and the C2 IP was blocked at the firewall. Full EPP scan confirmed presence of Webshell.PHP.Generic.A.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Webshell PHP File Creation in Web Root
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
  service: auditd
conditions:
  - event.action: 'file_create'
  - target.filename|endswith: '.php'
  - target.file.path|startswith: '/var/www/html/'
  - target.file.size < 50KB
  - target.file.owner: 'www-data'
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate PHP file deployments by DevOps
level: high
